mentions.h: 12th NOVEMBER1983 WIMBLEDON SOUTH OF THE THAMES JUNIOR

photos.c: Left. First year Junior Adam Christie has proved that with hard work he has the makings of a fine athlete. Pictured here in the Surreys he could well help us to a 4th consecutive win next year.
